sections.section: RULES - Balochistan Ship Breaking Industry Rles 1979
sections.description:
BALOCHISTAN SHIP BREAKING
BALOCHISTAN SHIP BREAKING
INDUSTRY RLES, 1979
(Amendment of Sub-R.(2) of
R.15)
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary,
8th October, 2011]
No.P&D-BDA(313)/2011/7951,
dated 8-10-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section 30 of the
Balochistan Development Authority Act, 1947 (Act No.X of 1974), the Government
of Balochistan is pleased to make the following amendment in the Balochistan
Ship Breaking Industry Rules, 1979, with immediate effect.
2. In
the aforesaid Rules, in rule 15 in sub-rule (2) for the words and figures
Rs.30/- per tonnage fee appearing after words "at the rate of", the
words and figures will be "Rs.100 per ton" shall be substitutes with
immediate effect.
